key_points.text: Chris Meredith is co-chief investment officer and director of research at O'Shaughnessy asset management.
key_points.evidence_quote: Chris Meredith is co-chief investment officer and director of research at O'Shaughnessy asset management.

key_points.text: In this episode, we focus on the latter title and talk all about what it means to develop a strong research program.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, we focus on the latter title and talk all about what it means to develop a strong research program.

key_points.text: Our conversation centers around what Chris considers to be the three key pillars, data, tools, tools, and people.
key_points.evidence_quote: Our conversation centers around what Chris considers to be the three key pillars, data, tools, tools, and people.

key_points.text: Chris provides insight into how data has changed since the beginning of his career.
key_points.evidence_quote: Chris provides insight into how data has changed since the beginning of his career, starting with highly structured price and fundamental data to so-called pointy, highly specific data sets, and now completely unstructured blobs of information.

thesis: The episode discusses the three key pillars of a strong research program: data, tools, and people. It highlights the shift from structured data to unstructured information, the role of open-source software and machine learning in tools, and the necessity of skilled people to maximize team potential.
